text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon—Sweep Tosho was uncharacteristically
immersed in studying her textbook.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mumu... Mumumu...
When the wind force is..., the object is...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Fufun! If you wanna be a great witch, you've gotta be smart too, so this is only natural!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Today, we learned about wind power in science class.
The force that wind exerts on an object is, uh... something something...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Anyway! If we use the power of the wind,
it means we can run even faster than before!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll summon some wind with my magic right now and see how fast it makes me!
Come on, to the track!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Whether by coincidence or not, the moment Sweep Tosho cast her spell, a strong gust of wind began blowing across the track!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I did it! A success, total success!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, this is no time to celebrate!
Riding the tailwind to go faster than usual... Aaah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, a fierce gust of wind
blew Sweep Tosho's hat right off!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait upーー!
Wind, stop! Stop blowing alreadyーー!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, but somehow, running alongside the wind felt so good—I might've been in better shape than usual!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to chasing her hat all over the place,
Sweep Tosho seemed to have grasped something,
and from that day on, her running gained a sharper edge!
